title: AI neural network demo
summary: A visual walkthrough of how a neural network is wired up and how it actually learns.
body:
A little visual walkthrough of how a neural network works under the hood. It steps through the Network, a single Neuron, the Forward Pass, Training, and where this stuff actually gets Used, with a simulation running alongside each section so the math feels less abstract.

The embed below is the live demo.

title: AI tokenizer demo
summary: A tiny playground for seeing how text gets chopped into tokens before a model ever sees it.
body:
A little demo for poking at how text turns into tokens. Type something in, watch it get broken down, and get a feel for why models think in chunks instead of letters or words.

The embed below is the live demo. It listens for a theme message from this site, so flipping the site between light and dark flips the demo too.

title: AI transformer explainer
summary: An interactive look at how a transformer actually turns text into predictions.
body:
A little playground for poking at how a transformer actually processes text. It walks through tokenization, embeddings, attention, and the path from input to predicting the next token. The kind of explainer I wish I had when I first started reading the papers.

The embed below is the live demo. It listens for a theme message from this site, so flipping the site between light and dark flips the demo too.
